rule: every feature at origin t uses only observations with available_at <= t; runtime and offline share the same functions

families.window: as-of <= t, at most 30 min old
families.cleaning: causal: range (0,100), importer flatline flag, plateau >= 60 min measured up to the reading

families.window: as-of at t and at t - {1,3,6} h, at most 30 min old

families.available_at: sample_time + 240 min (analyser pairing window ends sample + 30 min < publication)
families.window: last 10 published samples within 45 days; level = median of last 5
families.mutation_test: test_dynamics_and_lab_features_ignore_future_mutations (labs sampled before t but published after t are mutated)

families.available_at: t (computed from the families above with a Stage-1 model fitted on windows ending before its cutoff)

training_only_quantities.name: Stage-1 target
training_only_quantities.definition: ln mean analyser over (t+h-30, t+h+30] minus ln analyser now
training_only_quantities.boundary: row used before a cutoff / inside a fold only if t+h+30 < boundary

training_only_quantities.name: quiet_future mask
training_only_quantities.definition: whole control path (t, t+h+30] within tolerance, observed without gaps > 30 min
training_only_quantities.boundary: same as the Stage-1 target window; never a runtime input

training_only_quantities.name: Stage-2 label
training_only_quantities.boundary: fit: published before cutoff; fold scoring: published before fold end

training_only_quantities.name: support/applicability envelope
training_only_quantities.boundary: labels published before the model set's cutoff (fold start for outer folds)

training_only_quantities.name: residual quantiles
training_only_quantities.boundary: outer out-of-fold predictions only (configuration chosen on earlier folds)

training_only_quantities.name: control response (scenario defaults)
training_only_quantities.boundary: analyser/control data strictly before fit_end (unchanged from v4)

training_only_quantities.name: anomaly thresholds
training_only_quantities.boundary: rows before fit_end, quantiles scored on folds ending by fit_end (unchanged from v4)
